description.en: The phase drawing: the design lead draws the screens the plan's pieces change as clickable HTML mock-ups in the phase folder; another role checks them against the pieces and the design system.
description.ru: Чертёж фазы: дизайнер рисует экраны, которые меняют куски плана, кликабельными HTML-макетами в папке фазы; другая роль проверяет их по кускам и дизайн-системе.

pieces.note: the plan's pieces that change a screen: id, title, promise

folder.note: the phase folder relative to the project; mock-ups go to <folder>/design/

nodes.prompt:
Draw every screen the pieces in `pieces` change, as a clickable gray HTML mock-up (one file per screen) under `<folder>/design/`, following the project's DESIGN.md when there is one. Each file names the piece ids it serves. Also write `<folder>/design/UI-SPEC.md`, the drawing's contract that the verification checks: for each screen its piece ids, its states (empty, loading, error, filled) and its breakpoints, as checkable points. Write nothing outside `<folder>/design/`.
List the files you wrote in `paths` (relative to the project), UI-SPEC.md among them. Set `feasible` false and say why in `contradiction` when a piece cannot be drawn as asked (the pieces contradict each other or the design system).

Read the mock-ups in `draw.paths` and the pieces in `pieces`. You did not draw them. For each piece: is its screen there, does it show the promised behaviour, does it follow DESIGN.md, and does UI-SPEC.md list its screen's states and breakpoints. Answer `verdict` pass or rework, with `notes` naming what to change; rework only for a missing screen, a broken promise or a design-system break, not for taste.
